sections.name: Header
sections.instructions: Crystal glass sticky header (z-50) using `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50`. Brand logo left, nav links center (hidden on mobile), 'Book Now' CTA right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.instructions: Headline: 'Professional Cleaning Services in Dubai — Fast, Reliable & Affordable'. Layout: Split 50/50 on desktop, stacked on mobile. Use `hero_image` with subtle rounded corners (rounded-3xl). Primary CTA: WhatsApp button. Secondary CTA: 'View Pricing' anchor link.

sections.name: Trust & Brands
sections.instructions: Simple horizontal flex layout with checkmarks for: 'Background Checked', 'Fully Insured', 'Eco-friendly Products', 'Same Day Service'.

sections.name: Services
sections.instructions: Bento grid or responsive standard grid. Cards: Home Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Move-in/Move-out, Office Cleaning, Sofa & Carpet Cleaning. Map to the provided `media.services` images where applicable. Use Lucide icons for the others.

sections.name: How It Works
sections.instructions: 3 steps: 1. Book Online/WhatsApp, 2. We Clean, 3. You Relax. Use large typography numbers (`text-8xl text-slate-100 font-black absolute`) behind the step content for a premium layered look.

sections.name: Before & After
sections.instructions: Stacked on mobile, side-by-side flex on desktop. Use `cleaning_pro` image and `services.bathroom` to demonstrate pristine results.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.instructions: Two minimal pricing cards. 1. Standard (Starting from AED 45/hour), 2. Deep Clean (Custom quote). Focus on transparency. Use checkmarks for features.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.instructions: Horizontal scroll or grid of 3 reviews. Use `media.testimonials` for user avatars. Highlight locations like 'Dubai Sports City' in the review text to build local trust.

sections.name: Contact & Map
sections.instructions: Contact form (Name, Phone, Service Dropdown) beside an embedded Google Map of Dubai. Include a prominent Click-to-call button. Use accessible Shadcn-like form inputs with clear borders.

sections.name: Mobile Sticky CTA
sections.instructions: Fixed bottom bar (`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-slate-200 z-50 md:hidden`) containing a full-width WhatsApp button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts: 'Outfit' (Headings) and 'Manrope' (Body). DO NOT USE INTER.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
Mobile-first constraint: Ensure the mobile sticky CTA is present and does not overlap footer links when scrolled.
Use generous padding `py-20` or `py-24` between main sections.
Images should have `object-cover` and rounded corners to match the premium, approachable brand vibe.
